header.title: How we work
header.subtitle: Integrated inside your business.
header.intro: We don't hand you a team and walk away. We embed in your context your stack, your data, your constraints and own the problem until it produces a measurable result.

context.title: Context before code
context.text: First we understand the business, the data and the real constraints. Code comes after, not before.

ownership.title: End-to-end ownership
ownership.text: A single owner of the problem, from discovery to measurement. We don't fragment responsibility.

seniority.title: Experience, not supervised hands
seniority.text: Professionals who make technical and product decisions in the same seat, with no intermediate layers.

phases.title: The process
phases.subtitle: Four phases, each with a verifiable close.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.text: We embed in your team and your stack. We get access to the systems, tools and people that matter from week one.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.text: Immersion in the real context and data. We identify where the value is and which constraints technical, regulatory, human shape the solution.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.text: Building under real constraints. We iterate in production, not in a lab environment, with visible milestones at every step.

measurement.title: Measurement
measurement.text: A quantified result, not a deliverable. We close on a business metric agreed upfront, monitored live.

risk.title: Risk reduction
risk.subtitle: Designed for the buyer who cannot afford to be wrong.

visibility.title: Continuous visibility
visibility.text: Access to real progress, not a monthly report. What we build is seen and tested live.

milestones.title: Short milestones
milestones.text: Brief, verifiable cycles. Every milestone is a decision point, not an act of faith.

deliverables.title: Measurable deliverables
deliverables.text: Every phase closes on something verifiable against an agreed criterion, not against an opinion.

timeToValue.title: Time-to-value
timeToValue.text: Value arrives before the project closes. You validate the direction while you can still correct it.
